description:
FILED s448p (agent P) from the #527 probes; PRE-EXISTING (the postfix-deref
emitters never ask _is_paren_scalar_base -- it has exactly five call sites, all
in the `->method` / `->(...)` / `->[i]` / `->{k}` emitters), so #527's fix does
not reach it.

REPRO (perl vs ./runpcl):
  use v5.24;
  my $r = [10,20]; my $h = {a=>1,b=>2}; my $s = \"SV";
  print "pd1=", join(",", (1,2,$r)->@*), "\n";          # perl 10,20   PCL 1,2,ARRAY(0x1)
  print "pd2=", join(",", sort keys +(1,$h)->%*), "\n"; # perl a,b     PCL a,b     (already right)
  print "pd3=", (1,$s)->$*, "\n";                       # perl SV      PCL 1SCALAR(0x2)
  print "pd4=", scalar((1,2,$r)->@*), "\n";             # perl 2       PCL 2       (already right)

WHY: `->` on a parenthesised expression takes ONE scalar value in every
context -- the comma operator's LAST element -- and that is as true for the
postfix-deref spellings as for the four the family already covers.  The `@*`
and `$*` emitters lower their base in whatever context it carries, so a
multi-element group flattens into the result.  `%*` and the scalar-context
`@*` happen to answer right today; do not read that as "half of it works" --
they are two spellings that force a scalar somewhere else.

FIX SHAPE (not designed): route the postfix-deref emitters through the same
_is_paren_scalar_base / _gen_scalar_deref_base_form pair the other four use
(rule 11 -- ONE predicate, not a sixth copy of the test).  Grep
Pl/ExprToCL.pm for the `->@*` / `->%*` / `->$*` / `->&*` / `->**` emitters
first; a fifth and sixth call site of an existing predicate is the whole
change, if the emitters are shaped like their siblings.

BAR: the four rows above + the SINGLE-element base of each spelling (already
right, must stay right) + the bare `$r->@*` spelling + `->&*` and `->**` +
lvalue/slice spellings (`(1,$r)->@[0,1]`, `(1,$h)->@{qw(a b)}`); Pl/ change so
corpus-diff + emission-ab over the four populations; guard rows beside the
#527 family in Pl/t/anon-sub-01.t.  Note perl-tests/postfixderef.t is the
population file most likely to move.


DONE s451y (Opus, round 10 agent Y), commit 8b71893.  _paren_deref_base_form (over the existing _is_paren_scalar_base + _gen_scalar_deref_base_form) at SIX sites: the sigil cast, $#, and the four slice emitters; $keep_lvalue added to the helper because a deref base AUTOVIVIFIES (@{ ($h{k}) } = (7,8)) where an arrow invocant does not.  `->&*` and `->**` were not parsed at all and now lower onto the `&`/`*` prefix casts (two characters wider in the two places that know the postfix grammar).  34 probes vs perl: 22 disagreed before, 0 after.  Corpus-diff 1 of 111 (multideref.t's qw(...)->$* base); 1007-file A/B DIFF 1 (the same file) -- the postfixderef shapes live inside eval q{} strings, so they move at RUN time, not in the emission.  EXPECTED SWEEP MOVE: perl-tests/postfixderef.t 96/25 -> 100/21 (6 fixed by description; rows 72/73 'PVBM is not a GLOB ref' now fail HONESTLY -- they were passing because the statement DROPPED and the eval died).  Guard Pl/t/anon-sub-01.t 59 -> 70.  Residue FILED as #720 (an lvalue slice through an autovivified element writes nowhere -- pre-existing, the paren is a red herring).
